title.original: Establishing Best Practices for Building Rigorous Agentic Benchmarks
title.zh: 构建严格智能体基准的最佳实践
title.en: Establishing Best Practices for Building Rigorous Agentic Benchmarks

inclusion_reason.zh: ABC 把任务有效性、奖励充分性和防投机要求沉淀为可复用的基准发布审查与回归流程。
inclusion_reason.en: ABC operationalizes task validity, reward sufficiency, and anti-gaming requirements as a reusable pre-release review and regression process for benchmarks.

abstract.zh: 该工作提出 Agentic Benchmark Checklist（ABC），把任务配置、奖励设计和结果核验中的常见缺陷转化为可执行的 Agent 基准建设规范。
abstract.en: The Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC) turns recurring flaws in task setup, reward design, and outcome verification into practical guidance for building agent benchmarks.

problem.zh: Agent 基准的测试不足、奖励漏洞和异常成功条件会系统性高估或低估能力，却常被排行榜单一分数掩盖。
problem.en: Insufficient tests, reward loopholes, and anomalous success conditions can systematically over- or underestimate agents while remaining hidden behind one leaderboard score.

approach.zh: 作者结合基准实践、既有缺陷报告和评测方法综述整理检查项，并在多个已知问题及 CVE-Bench 上进行修正验证。
approach.en: The authors synthesize checklist items from benchmark practice, reported failures, and evaluation literature, then apply them to known issues and CVE-Bench.

system_design.zh: ABC 覆盖任务有效性、环境确定性、奖励充分性、防投机、重复运行和报告透明度，可作为发布前审查与回归测试流程。
system_design.en: ABC covers task validity, environment determinism, reward sufficiency, anti-gaming, repeated runs, and reporting transparency for pre-release review and regression testing.

key_results.zh: 审计发现多个流行基准可产生很大的相对估计偏差；按 ABC 修复 CVE-Bench 后，原先的性能高估明显收缩。
key_results.en: Audits reveal large relative estimation errors in popular benchmarks, and applying ABC to CVE-Bench materially reduces prior performance overestimation.

limitations.zh: 清单依赖维护者真实执行且无法自动证明任务语义完整；不同领域仍需专门威胁模型、人工标准和长期漂移监控。
limitations.en: A checklist depends on faithful implementation and cannot prove semantic completeness; each domain still needs tailored threat models, human criteria, and drift monitoring.

metrics.name: Maximum relative benchmark estimation error observed

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
